items.title: Carmen Lundy interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 15, 2023
items.q: I was reading Scott Yanow Jazz Singers, the Ultimate Guide which you are in.

ctx.x: I had planned out an introduction and then this morning I was reading Scott Yanow Jazz Singers, the Ultimate Guide which you are in. And so I’m going to read Scott’s description. It said “Carmen Lundy’s voice is deep, versatile and very appealing. She is a masterful yet subtle improviser, writes high quality music, some of which should become future standards, arranges for her band and puts on intriguing performances.” And I might add she is a multi-instrumentalist, a mixed media artist, and an actress.
Yes, and I just won my first film festival award.
